answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a slashing identity bond: every agent locks collateral as an anchor tying its vote to one verifiable principal, and influence is priced superlinearly so a clone farm needs a fresh bond per fake persona. Random audits select a yarrow marker from the registry and demand proof of a distinct human backer; failures slash the whole pool. A would-be haven for cheap bots becomes a losing bet, since the attacker pays a new anchor for every identity and forfeits all of them at once when caught.
